hero.name: [[[ const h=new Date().getHours(); return h<11?'Guten Morgen':h<17?'Guten Tag':'Guten Abend'; ]]]
hero.label: Willkommen zuhause

custom_fields.weather: [[[ const e=states["climate.wohnzimmer_mqtt_hvac"]; const t=e?.attributes?.current_temperature; return `🌡${t == null ? "—" : String(t).replace(".",",") + " °C"}Innen · Wohnzimmer`; ]]]

status.label: [[[ const e=states[entity.entity_id]; if(!e || ['unknown','unavailable'].includes(e.state))return 'Nicht verfügbar'; const s={armed_home:'Aktiv (Zuhause)',armed_away:'Aktiv (Abwesend)',armed_night:'Aktiv (Nacht)',disarmed:'Deaktiviert',arming:'Aktivierung läuft',triggered:'ALARM',jammed:'Verklemmt',locked:'Verriegelt',unlocked:'Entriegelt',home:'Zuhause',not_home:'Abwesend',on:'Ein',off:'Aus'}; return s[e.state]||e.state; ]]]

quick.label: [[[ const id=variables.status_entity; const s=states[id]; if(!s) return ""; if(variables.status_kind==="climate"){ const t=s.attributes.current_temperature; return (s.state==="off"?"Aus":"Aktiv") + (t == null?"":" · "+String(t).replace(".",",")+" °C"); } if(variables.status_kind==="cover"){const p=s.attributes.current_position; return p != null ? p+" %" : (s.state==="open"?"Offen":s.state==="closed"?"Geschlossen":"Rollläden");} if(variables.status_kind==="car"){return s.state==="on"?"Bereit":"Laden aus";} if(s.state==="on")return "Ein"; if(s.state==="off")return "Aus";return s.state; ]]]

card.border: [[[ return variables.active ? "1px solid rgba(168,219,255,.27)" : "1px solid transparent"; ]]]

hint: Large config (96,050 bytes). Pass view_path=... to fetch a single view, or use ha_config_get_dashboard(entity_id=...) to find card positions, then ha_config_set_dashboard(python_transform=...) instead of full config replacement.
